analogy.rationale: Renin is a secreted aspartyl protease of the renin-angiotensin system; its only known substrate is angiotensinogen, and the nine cell lines are not renin-expressing juxtaglomerular cells, so renin inhibitors should elicit little or no transcriptional response. Other RAS-targeting classes (ACE inhibitors, angiotensin receptor antagonists) act on the same pathway but likewise have minimal direct transcriptional impact in these cells.
